# The playful little extras

## quiz.json
Your personalized questions. Edit each question and its answers. Every answer has a label and a reply; there are no wrong answers or blocked paths. Make these your inside jokes. Add or remove questions freely, keeping at least one question and two answers per question. Keep valid JSON (double quotes, no trailing commas).

## coupon.json
The private movie screening invitation beneath the scratch card. She can choose OK Kanmani, Alaipaayuthey, or type her own movie. Her selection is included on the saved invitation and stays for the current page visit; it is not sent to a server. Edit title, message, and footer. The current gift is a private movie screening with you. Use \n inside a JSON string for a line break.

## Saved keepsake
The finale's Save this little memory button creates a PNG containing the birthday greeting and your full future letter. The scratch card also offers a save button for the date coupon. Both show an image preview with a Download PNG link and a press-and-hold save option for phones. They work entirely in her browser.

The quiz is optional. The scratch card has a Reveal without scratching button for keyboard access. Optional sound is synthesized chimes, starts off, and plays only after interaction. No recordings or microphone are used.
